title: Sort Array By Parity II
description: Given an array of integers, half are even and half are odd. Sort the array so that when i is even, nums[i] is even, and when i is odd, nums[i] is odd.
pseudocode:
1: let even = 0, odd = 1
2: while even < n and odd < n:
3:   if nums[even] % 2 == 0: even += 2
4:   else if nums[odd] % 2 != 0: odd += 2
5:   else: swap(nums[even], nums[odd])

steps.note: Initialize even pointer at 0 and odd pointer at 1.
nums[1] is 2 (even), mismatch found at odd pointer.
Even pointer exceeds bounds, loop terminates.
